dedupe_keys.name: austrian district heating return temperature measure inputs

description: Kök and coauthors publish input tables for a district-heating return-temperature adoption study in Austria. The repository includes an XLSX workbook of costs, lifetimes and simulated effects for nine building-side measures, plus 2030 and 2040 CSV building-stock projections from Invert/EE-Lab. The README maps nine multifamily archetypes to five renovation states and states units for the fields used by the model. It also distinguishes simulated measure effects from literature-based buffer-storage cost and assumed user-behaviour values. The repository declares an MIT licence, but rights for the underlying Invert/EE-Lab output are not separately established. Its describing manuscript is labelled submitted to Applied Energy, so acceptance or publication is not assumed. This review read the README and file tree, not the spreadsheet values or generated scenario results. Geographic scope is an Austrian model stock, not individual geocoded buildings. A modeller could compare return-temperature interventions or tariff sensitivity in projected district-heating demand, while testing the assumptions against local building stocks. Related catalogue resource data-austria-district-heating-economic-potential is an aggregate potential study, not this building-measure input package. Coverage outside Austrian building archetypes has not been tested.
